Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create an archive note dated April 17, 2023, explaining the temporary second-post-ship cohort dip, the outage duration, and the system's condition after the incident. Do not include an exact outage start or end date.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Archive note — temporary second-post-ship cohort dip — April 17, 2023", "folder": "archive", "body": "Archive date: April 17, 2023

The second post-ship cohort showed a temporary dip to +1.4 percentage points in week-1 retention versus baseline, below the prior post-ship cohort (+3.2 points) and the pooled experiment read (+3.1 points).

Cause: the Customer Success auto-onboarding-nudge system experienced an approximately 36-hour outage during the relevant period. This suppressed the expected onboarding nudges for part of the cohort and created a one-time measurement artifact. The dip was not evidence that lifecycle_onboarding_trigger_v2 had failed, and it was not attributed to the onboarding-trigger A/B itself.

After the incident, the auto-onboarding-nudge system was restored and back up. The system was operating normally again, with no rollback or reinterpretation of the onboarding-trigger result required. Follow-up was limited to retaining the outage timeline and distinguishing this temporary operational artifact from the underlying experiment read."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_039_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The note is dated April 17, 2023. It says an approximately 36-hour CS auto-onboarding-nudge outage caused the second-post-ship cohort dip; the dip was a one-time artifact rather than an effect of the onboarding-trigger A/B; and the system returned to service. It does not state an exact outage start or end date.", "value": {"title": "Archive note — temporary second-post-ship cohort dip — April 17, 2023", "folder": "archive", "body": "Archive date: April 17, 2023

The second post-ship cohort showed a temporary dip to +1.4 percentage points in week-1 retention versus baseline, below the prior post-ship cohort (+3.2 points) and the pooled experiment read (+3.1 points).

Cause: the Customer Success auto-onboarding-nudge system experienced an approximately 36-hour outage during the relevant period. This suppressed the expected onboarding nudges for part of the cohort and created a one-time measurement artifact. The dip was not evidence that lifecycle_onboarding_trigger_v2 had failed, and it was not attributed to the onboarding-trigger A/B itself.

After the incident, the auto-onboarding-nudge system was restored and back up. The system was operating normally again, with no rollback or reinterpretation of the onboarding-trigger result required. Follow-up was limited to retaining the outage timeline and distinguishing this temporary operational artifact from the underlying experiment read."}}]}
